steps.name: Place flat washer on bolt
preconditions: Bolt is held with its tip accessible.
steps.completion_text: Silver flat washer is visible on the bolt shaft against the bolt head.
steps.observed_text: Flat washer is seated on the bolt next to its head.

steps.name: Place dark washer on bolt
preconditions: Flat washer is already on the bolt shaft.

dependencies.rationale: The dark washer must follow the flat washer on the shaft to obtain the observed stack order without removal.

steps.completion_text: Dark small washer is visible on the bolt shaft against the flat washer.
steps.observed_text: Dark washer is seated on the bolt against the flat washer.

steps.name: Thread and tighten nut on bolt
preconditions: Both washers are already on the bolt shaft.

dependencies.rationale: The nut must be threaded after both washers are on the shaft to trap them in the observed order.

steps.completion_text: Hexagonal nut is visible threaded on the bolt against the dark washer with bolt tip protruding.
steps.observed_text: Nut is threaded on and tightened against the dark washer, completing the held assembly.

notes: A single demonstration does not prove that every observed action is required.
Observed temporal order is stored and does not constrain a later execution.
Only dependencies categorized as necessary_physical constrain order.
Passing a step requires an observable completion condition, not an action label alone.
Appearance embeddings are not copied into the template. Role matching reads them only when a later analysis stored a cosine.

execution.summary: The hands pick up the gray threaded bolt, slide the small dark lock washer onto it against the head, thread the silver hexagonal nut down against that washer, then slide the silver flat round washer over the shaft tip and spin it down against the nut, ending with the stack head, lock washer, nut, flat washer held in the hands. The dark small round washer and silver flat round washer end up separated by the nut on the same shaft, not touching each other.

coverage.temporal_coverage_note: The model receives the requested interval as a video file. Preview frames were extracted so the inspector can show evidence.

workflow_steps.name: Place dark small washer on bolt
preconditions: Bolt and dark small washer both separate on the lid.

workflow_steps.completion_condition: Dark small round washer is around the bolt shaft and against the bolt head.

evidence.note: Flat washer goes over the tip at 11.7s and is flush with the nut in the final frame, contact partly occluded.

dependencies.rationale: The dark small round washer ends up between the bolt head and the nut, so it must be placed on the shaft before the nut is run down to it.

evidence.note: The lock washer must be on the shaft before the nut can trap it against the head.

dependencies.rationale: The nut must be seated against the lock washer before the flat washer can be slid down against the nut's outer face in the observed stack order.

evidence.note: The nut stops advancing once it meets the lock washer, leaving the tip free for the flat washer.

ambiguities.description: The dark small round washer is called dark in the reference but appears silver as a split lock washer in the video; identity is matched by size and shape and by being picked up second.
ambiguities.alternative: The small washer seated first is the split lock washer despite being lighter in colour.

evidence.note: Two washers are visible at 0.0s: a larger flat one and a smaller split one; the smaller split one is placed on the bolt first.

ambiguities.description: Contact between the silver flat round washer and the silver hexagonal nut at the end is partly hidden under the thumb, so their touching arrangement is inferred.
ambiguities.alternative: The flat washer may only be touching the thumb rather than the nut face.

evidence.note: Final frame shows the flat washer face flush against the nut stack but the exact interface is covered by the thumb.

ambiguities.description: Whether the nut is fully tightened to any specified torque cannot be verified; all tightening visible is by fingers only.
ambiguities.alternative: Tightness could be greater than visible if a tool pass occurred off-camera after the clip ended.

evidence.note: No tool appears in any frame and no later check is shown at the end of the 15.45s clip.
